scope: Entire actual corollary, all hypotheses and proof, both sufficient period conditions, and final recognition remark read.
checks: Perfectness of S forces its field projection to vanish, so the prescribed outer map fixes exactly one field character on H0. B0 and H0 need not be normal.
The period condition is measured on the kernel of that field character, precisely matching the proved semilinear hereditary theorem. No constant-band substitution is used.
Actual nonsplit wreath transport counts lift classes modulo S; crown surjectivity forces distinct coordinate classes. The existing transport does not split the outer extension.

Ambient PGL conjugacy splits into at most |PGL| actual restrictions, regardless of whether ambient conjugators normalize B0 or S. Faithfulness identifies each such homomorphism with at most one actual B0 map.
S-normalization of the restriction and a-1 coset representatives yield |S|^(a-1) extension choices without requiring H0 normal. The exponent and c_R agree with the stated maximum and ceiling.
The existing LMT crown bound retains d(P); no global or permutation-group generator bound is inserted.

A nonzero bilinear or quadratic form makes its semisimilitude factor unique. Exact composition is lambda(gh)=lambda(g)*sigma_g(lambda(h)), and scalar cI has factor c^2. The argument also holds for quadratic forms in characteristic two.

Applying the actual multiplier character to chosen semilinear lifts makes c(g,h)^2 a twisted coboundary. Thus the full twisted obstruction, its field-kernel restriction and geometric image have exponent dividing2.
The gcd sufficient condition and precise actual-embedding hypothesis are retained; no unchecked named-family automorphism recognition or unbounded residual outer-index claim.
